_doc: Which bib family does a LIVE body pin? — the shared corpus for the ONE rule (task 1371). The app reader is src/lib/__tests__/body-family-pin.test.ts (bodyPinnedFamily, detectBodyRequirements, detectBibFamily, the collector/serializer fold); the editor reader is editor/scripts/tests/test_body_family_pin_parity.py (bib_family.body_pinned_family / detect_bib_family). `family` is the pinned family or null; `seed` is detectBibFamily over a preamble that loads no bib package.
